title: session-policy-ledger-and-stream-presets: unify session profiles and retry/stream ergonomics
author: Hannah Li
description: Context: Parity work across the three SDKs (TS primary) to standardize a small session policy ledger and a set of ergonomic defaults for streaming + retry presets. Motivation: teams have had subtle cross-SDK differences in how session heartbeats, retry windows, and stream priming behave which led to skewed telemetry and surprising reconnection behavior for long-lived connections. This PR introduces a light-weight session policy ledger (TS-side implementation and public types) plus a named set of 'stream presets' that encode recommended retry/backoff/priming combinations for common app profiles (interactive low-latency, batching/cold-start-tolerant, high-throughput background). The change is intentionally opt-in for existing customers but becomes the new default for fresh clients to improve cross-language parity and observability. Summary of changes: added session policy ledger types, a small runtime that annotates session handles with policy metadata, three stream presets (interactive, batch-friendly, background-throughput) with documented defaults, a tiny telemetry hook to emit session.policy_applied events, TS SDK version bump to 2.3.0, and examples/docs updates. Checklist: - [x] design doc reviewed (ENG-1842) - [x] cross-sdk alignment notes posted and small patches queued for go/python - [x] unit + integration tests for stream presets - [x] e2e smoke test against hosted API - [x] docs + changelog entry Notes: The leader for cross-sdk followups is Morgan Chen; companion PRs were opened against redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-go to mirror the policy shape (links: Linear ENG-1877). Rollout plan: default presets are behind a runtime flag (enableSessionLedger) for the next release window; after telemetry looks healthy for 2 weeks we will flip the default for new installs only, existing clients remain unaffected unless they opt in.

merge_commit_message:
squash: unify session policy ledger + stream presets (TS)

Introduce a light-weight session policy ledger, stream presets for ergonomic retry/priming defaults, small runtime to annotate/apply policies, telemetry hook, tests, and docs. Bump TS SDK to 2.3.0.
discussion_summary: Cross-SDK parity push to reduce operational surprises for long-lived streams. Key follow-ups: coordinate minor naming changes to python/go (PR links provided in Linear), watch session.policy_applied telemetry for 2 weeks after enabling default for new clients, and add an observability dashboard to track preset adoption and reconnect rates.
release_notes: Added: session policy ledger (TS SDK) and named stream presets (interactive, batch, background). Defaults for new installs can be enabled via enableSessionLedger flag; no breaking changes for existing clients. Bumped typescript SDK to 2.3.0.
backport_plan: No immediate backports; if customers request the feature for older branches, we will cherry-pick minimal runtime + types into release/* branches behind the same runtime flag.
notes_for_ops: When flipping default for new installs, enable observability dashboard to monitor: session.policy_applied count, reconnect rate (1m/5m), percent of streams using 'interactive' preset, and token priming distribution. If reconnects spike >3x baseline, roll back the flag and open ENG-1877 for triage.
